parallelSourceSteps.title: Public registration binding
parallelSourceSteps.inputs: Existing observed configuration/registration outputs only; derive exact endpoint,CA/RoleID/SecretID source paths and service/backup references without reading private values.
parallelSourceSteps.implementation: Build a bounded public projection using the already reviewed finite collector discipline. Unknown or unresolved fields stay unresolved; only actually named files can form a later exact readset.
parallelSourceSteps.output: Public production-binding with exact source blob/whole hash/field provenance and separate unresolved fields.

parallelSourceSteps.title: Private credential-source admission caller
parallelSourceSteps.inputs: Only paths authorized afterP01; exact held parent/name/FD plus mode/owner/nlink and raw SHA evidence; never generic env/home discovery.
parallelSourceSteps.implementation: Reuse Inputs lifetime/cancellation/once-close and exact frozen proof predicates; separate provider credential provenance from AppRole delivery credentials. Bind account/generation/lifetime without provider request. If expiry/drift fails, refuse; no refresh fallback.
parallelSourceSteps.output: Private capsule plus bounded public metadata/hash/closure, with explicit source scope and no values.

parallelSourceSteps.title: Production endpoint/ACL lifecycle verification source
parallelSourceSteps.inputs: Exact registered endpoint/cluster/namespace/CA/leaf, explicit role/secret source and public policy bytes fromP01/P02.
parallelSourceSteps.implementation: A separate exact executor must retain TLS trust and native unsupported guards; predeclare one login, actual lookup-self baseline/renewed lease observations, read/deny scope and revoke→deny checks. Treat unknown as stop; no silent retry or cluster initialization. Existing loopback-only caller is not relaxed to arbitrary addresses.
parallelSourceSteps.output: Per-operation request identity, response/receipt hashes, original absolute deadlines and final owner closure.

parallelSourceSteps.title: Per-host service/persistence/inverse source
parallelSourceSteps.inputs: Actual service unit/label/config and registered backup source from each host, all exact public identities. No Pocket-to-Mac/ROG/X230 extrapolation.
parallelSourceSteps.implementation: Prepare fixed compare-and-swap switch and inverse using actual before/candidate values, processbirth/manager ownership and bounded cold-start evidence. Backup registration/restore payload must be tied to the current host; preserve unrelated state and original unknowns.
parallelSourceSteps.output: One concrete reversible per-host request plus rollback/baseline evidence for review; no production cutover in current package.

nonGoals: No provider request, token refresh, model switch or quota modification
No production init/unseal/role creation/rotation or cutover
No Docker deletion from apparent emptiness
No reinterpretation of historical UNKNOWN or finite non-atomic observations
No fullreplacement or fullbackend compatibility conclusion
